title: SIG/CAIQ Answer Library and Attestation Onboarding with Conditional Pricing Triggers
creator: Nina Rahman
description: Build a curated, queryable SIG/CAIQ answer library and a lightweight customer self-attestation onboarding flow that integrates with contract pricing rules. The goal is to reduce sales/legal review time for standard enterprise customers, accelerate attestation delivery, and surface cases that require custom review. The deliverable will include QA'd canonical answers, a UI for customers to submit attestation metadata, an API endpoint for programmatic attestations, and a hook to our pricing engine to trigger conditional discounts or contract terms when customers accept standard controls.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical SIG/CAIQ answers covering 90% of common questions are documented and approved by Security and Legal
A customer-facing onboarding form exists that collects attestation metadata and generates a signed attestation PDF
API endpoint documented and available for SRE/Integration teams to fetch attestation status programmatically
Pricing engine receives a normalized attestation flag and applies conditional pricing rules in sandbox mode
Telemetry: time-to-attestation and % of customers using self-serve flow are measured in Console dashboard
